prompt: Our NestJS login-OTP flow sends a 6-digit code through a paid SMS provider, and Finance just flagged that the SMS bill has roughly doubled month-over-month even though sign-in volume is flat — nearly every verification code is being paid for twice. Below is the `OtpService.sendCode` method exactly as it runs in production today. Walk me through why the bill doubled, then redesign the send/resend logic so each verification intent is paid for at most once, resending only when delivery actually fails.
